tasks.title: Create model 'lab-dev'
tasks.instructions:
Create a new Juju model named `lab-dev`:

```bash
juju add-model lab-dev
```

tasks.title: Configure logging-config on 'lab-dev'
tasks.instructions:
Set the `logging-config` parameter to `<root>=INFO` on the `lab-dev` model:

```bash
juju model-config -m lab-dev logging-config="<root>=INFO"
```

tasks.title: Create 'lab-staging' and switch active model to 'lab-dev'
tasks.instructions:
Create another model named `lab-staging`, then explicitly switch your active Juju context back to `lab-dev`:

```bash
juju add-model lab-staging
juju switch lab-dev
```
